clockAlignment.method: Independently infer ts/1000 minus performance.now for each unique beforeinput mark on one renderer pid/tid; require all marks, at least two, offset spread <=1ms, and start/returned residuals <=1ms.

setterDescriptorProof.qualification: Proof is supplied by runtime descriptor comparison, not inferred from trace. React may retain reference-bound wrappers captured before mount; after stop these must be inactive pass-through delegates until context close. No React-owned instance descriptor mutation is inferred.

quantificationLimits: Diagnostic instrumentation perturbs execution; this report does not replace acceptance latency failures or demonstrate field INP.

The fully contained strict interval starts at the first beforeinput and ends strictly before the final beforeinput. Boundary-overlapping events are retained separately and can include automatic result work.

Trace inclusive durations nest. Union spans remove temporal double counting but do not identify exclusive CPU, renderer idle time, or causality. Do not add per-type unions or call program samples layout.
Event and setter associations are temporal containment only. Before/after selection getter probes may trigger or alter style/layout work.
Unmatched B/E spans and durations cut by trace capture remain unquantified. Source URLs are reduced to public HTTP(S) pathnames; raw arguments, typed text, key values, and URL queries are omitted.
Top durations and associations are limited to15 rows each. The runtime retains ignored raw trace/timeline files; this pure function does not read or write them.

layoutNodeEvidence.qualification: Trace argument filtering may omit node IDs. Only numeric root/node references emitted by measured main-thread Layout/style events are queried. No DOM text, input values or arbitrary attributes are retained. A resolved node identifies trace scope, not an exclusive layout cause.

strictPreFinalInput.qualification: LoAF reported script work only, with full temporal containment; not an exclusive or complete renderer CPU breakdown.
